notes.title: 🗡️ Ready to Become a GladMort Master?
notes.content:
Hey warriors!

Have you been braving the chaotic arenas of GladMort but still feel like there's more to master?

We’ve got you covered!

[b]📖 Check out the official GladMort guide [/b]
